notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U/R}{U/R}{U}.
description:
Activate all mana producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U/R}{U/R}{U}.
Activate Soulfire Grand Master by paying {2}{U/R}{U/R}, causing you to put the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn into your hand as it resolves.
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}, untapping all nonland permanents you control and putting Dramatic Reversal into your hand as it resolves due to Soulfire Grand Master.
Repeat.
